newsitem.title: CANADA: Foreigners buy Canada securities in September.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners buy Canada securities in September.

text.p: Foreign investors bought a net C$500 million Canadian securities in September, after selling a net C$13 million in August (revised from selling C$398 million), Statistics Canada said on Monday.
Canadian residents bought a net C$1.69 billion of foreign securities in September after buying C$1.11 billion in August (revised from C$1.15 billion).
